units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 9:6">Ḥull. IX, 6</cite> <he>ע׳ שחציו בשר וכ׳</he> a mouse which is half flesh and half earth (it being believed that there is a species of mice developing from earth, v. Maim. a. l.). Ib. 126ᵇ <he>ע׳ שבים</he> sea-mouse (name of a fish).

<cite ref="Horayot 13a:23">Hor. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>האוכל ממה שע׳ אוכל וכ׳</he> he who eats what a mouse has been gnawing at, will lose his memory; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עַכְבָּרִים</he>, <cite ref="P00721"><he>עַכְבָּרִין</he></cite>.
